content: {"episode_id": "ep-05045", "cpt": "93229", "denial_carc": "CO-197", "necessity_paragraph": "The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks and known sick sinus syndrome (diagnosis codes G45.9, I49.5, R42). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or conduction abnormalities that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring. This service is medically necessary to evaluate the patient's recurrent dizziness and giddiness in the context of the documented sick sinus syndrome and transient cerebral ischemic attacks."}
